theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Eucl P)) (M S : Set (Eucl P)) (f g F : Eucl P → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M μ → MeasurableSet S → Measurable f → (∀ Z : Set (Eucl P), Z ⊆ M → μ Z = 0 → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ν (Z ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) = 0) → (∀ x, x ∉ S → g x = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict M), x ∈ S → g x = F x) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∫ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν = ∫ x in {x | x ∈ M ∧ f x = t ∧ x ∈ S}, F x ∂ν
